qa.title: Q1054 (Jan. 31, 2025)
qa.question: Does "If this follower would take more than 3 damage, it takes 3 instead" mean that the selected follower can only take 3 damage a turn?
qa.answer: No, it means that any instance of damage dealt to the selected follower will be reduced to 3 if it exceeds 3 damage. For example, if the follower is attacked by two enemy followers with 4 attack, it will only take 3 damage from each attack. However, if the follower is attacked by an enemy follower with 4 attack and an enemy follower with 2 attack, it will take 3 damage and 2 damage from each attack respectively.

qa.title: Q1053 (Jan. 31, 2025)
qa.question: When playing this amulet's activated ability, if I choose option 3 and an ability lets me take two consecutive turns, does the selected follower still have "If this follower would take more than 3 damage, it takes 3 instead" during the consecutive turn?
qa.answer: No. However, the selected follower will have it for each opponent's next turn.

qa.question: When playing this spell, if there are 9 or less cards in opponents' cemeteries, can I select 5 enemy followers on the field?
qa.answer: No. You must allocate at least 1 damage to each follower you select for the target selection to be valid.

qa.title: Q1056 (Jan. 31, 2025)
qa.question: If there are no enemy followers on the field, but there are at least 20 cards in opponents' cemeteries, can I sill play this spell to deal 8 damage to each enemy leader?
qa.answer: Yes. "Select any number" means you can select 0 followers when playing this spell.

qa.question: If I discard this spell with Raio, Omen of Truth's Fanfare ability, can I still gain 1 Evolution Point?
qa.answer: No. When Raio, Omen of Truth is put on the field, this spell is considered to still be in your hand, and is only considered to be in the cemetery after Raio, Omen of Truth's Fanfare ability is resolved.

qa.answer: Yes, that's correct.

qa.question: Can I still gain 1 Evolution Point with this spell's automatic ability even if I'm the player going first?
qa.answer: Yes. Note that you can gain an Evolution Point even if you already have 3 Evolution Points.

qa.question: When playing this spell, if I have exactly 10 cards in my cemetery, including a Rulenye, Omen of Silence, will each opponent still have to discard a card after I summon that Rulenye, Omen of Silence from my cemetery?

qa.title: Q1108 (Jan. 31, 2025)
qa.question: Can you explain what type of card the evolved form of Eidolon of Madness is?
qa.answer:
The evolved form of Eidolon of Madness is an evolved amulet. Like a normal amulet, it doesn't have attack or defense, and only effects that target amulets apply to it.

When this amulet is destroyed, put it into its owner's cemetery. Immediately after movement, put the evolved amulet faceup on top of its owner's evolve deck like you would an evolved follower.

qa.title: Q1122 (Jan. 31, 2025)
qa.question: If I summon a Bahamut with this follower's Fanfare ability, and Bahamut's Fanfare ability destroys this follower, do I still have to return Bahamut to my hand at the start of my end phase?
qa.answer: Yes. Once this follower's Fanfare ability is resolved, Bahamut will have "At the start of your end phase, return this card to its owner's hand," which will remain valid even if this follower gets destroyed.

qa.title: Q1121 (Jan. 31, 2025)
qa.question: If I summon a Lucifer with this follower's Fanfare ability, do I still give my leader 4 defense even though that Lucifer returns to my hand at the start of my end phase?
qa.answer:
Yes. When you proceed to your end phase, all "At the start of your end phase" abilities are triggered and become pending. Then you can choose the order in which you resolve the pending abilities.

In this case, regardless of which ability you resolve first, you would give your leader 4 defense.

qa.title: Q1120 (Jan. 31, 2025)
qa.question: When playing this follower's Fanfare ability, if I have another copy of this follower in my hand, can I summon it?
qa.answer: Yes. Note that the summoned copy's Fanfare ability will also trigger.
